_meta.title: Measurement configuration — outbound clicks and page events
_meta.note: Canonical measurement configuration. One active runtime: assets/measure.js. The inherited alternative assets/track.js is no longer injected. The existing default five-event taxonomy is retained; no claim is made that the brief supplied their names. Counting remains OFF until durable production deployment evidence exists.

endpoint_status: Built and tested. Production not deployed: no durable authorized HTTPS collector host is available. The same-origin development preview runs the real aggregate collector; its counts are test traffic, not campaign evidence.
event_definitions_status: Canonical default runtime schema as of 2026-11-19: page_view, outbound_click, guide_view, intent_view, flag_view. Retained from the existing default stack; the alternative tracker is retired from runtime injection. The brief does not enumerate event names.

events.name: page_view
events.sends: event name, page path (no query string, no hash), protocol version.
events.does_not_send: visitor ID, IP address, user agent, referrer, cookies, screen or device data.

events.name: outbound_click
events.when: A primary or middle click on a sponsored Amazon product link with a supported public product token.
events.sends: Protocol version, event, approved page path, approved Amazon product host and known public product token only. Query strings and fragments are omitted.
events.does_not_send: the destination's query string, any tag value beyond what is in the path, or anything that identifies a person.

events.name: guide_view
events.when: Load of a non-index guide/article under /guides/, /site/guides/, /articles/ or /read/.

events.name: intent_view
events.when: Load of /intent-record/ or a corresponding intent-record.html page.

events.name: flag_view
events.when: Load of the flagged-for-review page or the publication pass page.

browser_rules: One runtime only; a global initialization guard prevents double counting if the script is accidentally loaded twice.
No cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage or visitor identifiers are written by the counter.
Global Privacy Control, Do Not Track or Save-Data disables all analytics requests.
If enabled is false, endpoint_url is empty or the endpoint is invalid, no analytics request is made.
Requests use fetch with credentials omitted, no referrer, text/plain JSON, keepalive and redirect:error. No sendBeacon credential fallback is used.
Search text and local suggestion-review choices are never analytics payload fields.
collector_rules: Accepts only the five named events, known public page paths and known Amazon host/product-token pairs. Extra fields are discarded; invalid data is rejected.
Requires an approved Origin; rejects unknown origins, unsupported content types and payloads over 2 KiB. A global write ceiling limits basic abuse without per-person identifiers.
Stores daily aggregate counts only, with 90-UTC-day automatic retention. No raw event rows, IP addresses, user agents, referrers or request logs are stored by the collector.
The server clock sets the day; client dates and identifiers are ignored.
GET /counts is disabled without the server-side Z3_ANALYTICS_READ_TOKEN and requires Bearer authorization when enabled. No read token is shipped to browsers.
The host/reverse proxy/CDN must be configured separately not to retain request logs. This repository cannot certify an undeployed host.
Event counts are not unique visitors, eligible sessions, orders, commissions or conversion rates.
